fieldValues.title: Reference-mode values resolve in the instanceIndex
fieldValues.normative_statement: A `mode: "reference"` value MUST resolve to an instance present in the repository's `instanceIndex`, and that instance MUST be of the Field's declared `rangeType` at the declared `typeVersion`. A dangling or type-mismatched target MUST be reported as an error naming the referring record, the key, and the target id. (RFC-039 [R14]; discharges RFC-032 OQ4, RFC-033:302, RFC-035:592)
